requirement:
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.

When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
rationale:
The requirement is satisfied by the reviewed implementation and referenced tests.

| Obligation | Implementation and verification |
|---|---|
| Include terminology referenced by the subject. | `src/authoring/inputs.rs#impl[AssessmentSources]/fn[prepare]` passes both the mandatory inputs and subject text to `definition_inputs`. `src/terms.rs#fn[direct_references]` scans them. `src/authoring/inputs.rs#mod[tests]/fn[bundle_combines_direct_references_terms_and_current_existing_selectors]` exercises a subject terminology reference and asserts the resulting two-definition set. |
| Include terminology referenced by any contributed source. | The same dependency scan examines each contributed input. `src/authoring/inputs.rs#mod[tests]/fn[mandatory_git_inputs_require_staging_declarations_sources_and_terms]` adds a term reference to an implementation source and verifies that its definition becomes mandatory (and that an inaccessible mandatory definition prevents preparation). |
| Contribute complete fenced declarations, including phrase options. | `src/authoring/inputs.rs#fn[definition_inputs]` resolves definition selectors through `source_input`; `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[resolve]` uses the declaration's raw lines, and `src/inputs.rs#impl[InputSelector]/fn[to_input]` includes that text. The additional-read conversation test below asserts declaration fences and phrase options in recorded definitions; `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[reading_records_only_delivered_sources_and_their_terms]` also asserts the supplied phrase option. These exercise the same declaration-resolution implementation used for mandatory inputs. |
| Include dependencies transitively. | `src/terms.rs#fn[close_dependencies]` expands references in definition bodies to a fixed point. The bundle test and additional-read conversation test both use mutually referencing definitions and assert the two-definition result. |
| Avoid duplicates. | The dependency closure uses sets, and `prepare` inserts dependencies only when absent. The bundle test asserts exactly two definitions for its two-node cycle; the additional-read conversation test asserts each name once. |
| Terminate on cycles. | `close_dependencies` tracks visited names before expanding their bodies. Both cyclic fixtures complete and assert their resulting sets. |
| Supply the same complete, transitive set when an additional read introduces terminology. | `src/authoring/tools.rs#fn[read]` calls `additional_definitions`; line-range reads use `src/authoring/pages.rs#impl[ResultPages]/fn[deliver]`, `definitions_each`, and `page_definitions`. `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[definitions_introduced_by_a_read_are_supplied_and_recorded_before_submission]` verifies cyclic transitive definitions and delivery in the request preceding submission. The tools test covers selector and line-range reads; `src/authoring/pages.rs#mod[tests]/fn[paged_inputs_carry_their_definitions_and_deliver_only_their_own_inputs]` verifies definitions accompany the relevant page. |
| Record those definitions before accepting submission. | `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[converse]` accumulates delivered inputs and calls `record_inputs` after the next successful response, before processing its submission. `src/authoring/inputs.rs#impl[AssessmentSources]/fn[record_inputs]` deduplicates recorded inputs. The additional-read conversation test asserts the definitions in final evidence and their earlier delivery; the tools test separately asserts recording deduplication. |

All implementation paths described above are reachable from the subject's marked `prepare` and `converse` roots. No unacknowledged gap was found.

text: :::{req} authoring_inputs
When preparing the mandatory input set defined by
{cite}`requirements.authoring.mandatory_inputs`, every terminology definition
referenced by the subject or any contributed source MUST contribute its complete
fenced declaration, including its phrase option. Definitions referenced by those
definitions MUST also be included transitively, without duplicates or
nontermination on cycles.
When an additional source read introduces a terminology dependency, the same
complete, transitive definition set MUST be supplied to the model and recorded
before accepting a submission.
:::{req} mandatory_inputs
The harness MUST construct each assessment's mandatory input set by combining
the contributions specified by the requirements applicable to that subject and
its inputs. A requirement that contributes inputs MUST cite this requirement and
define which sources it contributes and when. The harness MUST include every
applicable contribution, deduplicate identical selections, and report
unresolvable mandatory inputs before inference. The complete set MUST be supplied
in the initial model request.
Generated output under project-root `evidence/`, including symlink aliases, MUST
be omitted from mandatory inputs when the default exclusion applies. An explicit
workspace allow MUST permit those selections; an explicit disallow MUST abort
under {cite}`requirements.authoring.read_denial.mandatory`.
